scope: External command extraction and its compatibility checks

checks.evidence: IndexerCommandTemplate::replaceIndexerVariable uses the same find/replace/advance-by-replacement-length rule as utilityString.cpp::doReplace. Four expansion passes retain PROJECT, DATABASE_PATH, DATABASE_VERSION, SOURCE order, including same/earlier token non-recursion.

checks.property: Raw serialization and late database retargeting
checks.evidence: IndexerCommandCustom::doSerialize still serializes raw m_command/m_arguments. getCommand/getArguments expand current context; setDatabaseFilePath stays late-bound. Test assertions cover both properties.
Custom uses INDEXER_COMMAND_CUSTOM and configured runInParallel; Python uses INDEXER_COMMAND_PYTHON and true, preserving TaskExecuteCustomCommands discriminator behavior.
Both old loops and shared builder traverse sourceFiles std::set, selecting only membership in filesToIndex. No quoting or shell parsing was introduced.
The construction of index, --source-file-path, --database-file-path, optional environment, verbose and shallow arguments remains in SourceGroupPythonEmpty in its original order.
The extracted core supports UTF-8 std::string and std::wstring values without Qt or path I/O. This review does not establish execution behavior on Windows/macOS or Rust indexing support.

findings.initial_issue: The first builder draft took ProjectSettings by reference, eagerly dereferencing the pointer even for an empty selected-source intersection; the old loop never did so in that case.
findings.resolution: The builder now takes const ProjectSettings* and dereferences it only within the selected-source branch. New Catch assertions cover nullptr with empty source set and disjoint selection.
findings.verification: Confirmed updated source and assertions by inspection. C++ build/test execution is owned by the root integration run, not claimed by this reviewer.

toy_verification_tool_checks.not_run_here: The complete 22-case suite and all baseline metadata checks require the corrected real-CLI observations; root owns the final execution.
